summary: OpportunityOS v0.1 close-out FINAL FIX verification (iteration 9). BOTH P0 credential-leak fix AND P1 provable sealed masking are GREEN. Backend pytest tests/test_phase6_acceptance.py: 36/36 PASS (new: test_admin_user_detail_never_leaks_password_hash + test_admin_user_detail_masks_sealed_data). Custom sweep script /app/test_reports/sweep_admin_sensitive.py — clean across /admin/users, /admin/users/{id}, /admin/subscriptions, /admin/manual-queue, /admin/flags, /admin/support-tickets, /admin/health, /admin/observability/events, /admin/observability/errors — no `password_hash`, `totp_secret`, `recovery_codes`, or bcrypt marker ($2a$/$2b$/$2y$) in any response body for admin OR support. Sentinel sealed claim inserted directly via pymongo — retrieved via GET /admin/users/{fixture_id} for BOTH admin and support: (a) claim surfaced by id, (b) claim.value == '•••• (sealed)' exactly, (c) neither 'SENTINEL_SHOULD_NEVER_LEAK' nor '1234' present anywhere in body, (d) eligibility_profile IS present with sensitivity='sealed', (e) status/dates/notes/derived_flags all exactly '•••• (sealed)', (f) structural fields (user_id, version, sensitivity, updated_at, id) visible, (g) no 'unmask'/'reveal'/'decrypt' keyword in response body. Sentinel deleted on test teardown. SEALED_MASK literal confirmed '•••• (sealed)' (no emoji). Frontend verified via Playwright at /admin — logged in as admin, opened fixture-ead detail modal, [data-testid=admin-user-eligibility] block present and contains '•••• (sealed)' next to status/dates/notes/derived_flags + italic caption 'Sealed values are masked. No unmask path exists in v0.1.'. Screenshot at /app/test_reports/p6-user-detail-masked.png. Sanitized admin user-detail body (verbatim JSON) captured at /app/test_reports/p9-admin-user-detail-body.json — founder-requested artifact.

minor.issue: (carried over from iteration 8) counts.audit_logs is now correct but 'audit_events' remains a legacy naming artifact in privacy export bundle. Not touched by this iteration.

issues: (carried over from iteration 8) Sticky admin tabs visible behind the modal overlay in some viewports. Not a blocker; z-index tweak on modal container would fix.

critical_code_review_comments: domains/admin/service.py `_sanitize_user()` is a strong defence-in-depth pattern (projection + post-fetch scrub). Confirmed it strips {password_hash, password, totp_secret, recovery_codes} for admin AND support. Good.

SENSITIVE_USER_FIELDS is a module-level constant — recommend re-using the same allow/deny list wherever a User is serialized (e.g., /auth/me, /auth/register response). No leak seen there today, but centralizing prevents future regressions.

The sealed-mask logic in `_mask_sealed_profile` uses .lower() on sensitivity; also matches iteration-8 note about legacy claims writing `{'level':'sealed'}` shape — still applies. Consider a Pydantic model with a Literal type on `sensitivity` to prevent silent bypass.

Frontend Admin.jsx caption 'Sealed values are masked. No unmask path exists in v0.1.' contains the substring 'unmask' as a negation. This is fine and expected, but if the founder wants ZERO occurrences of the string 'unmask' in the DOM (defence-in-depth against grep-scans), rewording to 'Sealed values cannot be revealed in v0.1.' would satisfy that stricter interpretation. Current implementation follows PRD wording exactly.
